definitions.explanation: A natural or synthetic substance used in manufacturing. Natural resin comes from trees, while synthetic resin (plastic) is widely used in modern products. In everyday Japanese, often refers to plastic materials.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{樹脂|じゅし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This product is made of resin.

examples.japanese: {樹脂|じゅし}⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ケース→ケース：03841_keesu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{軽|かる}くて→軽い：00785_karui⟧⟦{丈夫|じょうぶ}→丈夫：01156_joubu⟧だ。
examples.english: Resin cases are light and durable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧{樹脂|じゅし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{合成|ごうせい}→合成：12027_gousei⟧{樹脂|じゅし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{性質|せいしつ}→性質：01638_seishitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: Natural resin and synthetic resin have very different properties.

notes:
USAGE:
In product descriptions and technical contexts, {樹脂|じゅし} often means "plastic" or "polymer." On product labels, {樹脂|じゅし}⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧ indicates the item is made of plastic/resin. Common in descriptions of watches, phone cases, and household items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{合成|ごうせい}→合成：12027_gousei⟧{樹脂|じゅし} (synthetic resin, plastic)
- ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧{樹脂|じゅし} (natural resin)
- {樹脂|じゅし}⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧ (made of resin/plastic)
- {樹脂|じゅし}⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧ (resin processing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦プラスチック→プラスチック：00347_purasuchikku⟧: plastic — the everyday loanword
- {樹脂|じゅし}: resin/plastic — more technical, used in product specs and manufacturing
